hooks.command: $j = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $j.tool_input.file_path; if ($f -and (Test-Path $f)) { $c = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($f); if ($c -match '\u2014') { (@{ hookSpecificOutput = @{ hookEventName = 'PostToolUse'; additionalContext = "GUARDRAIL: Em dash (the character —) found in $f. Remove every em dash and replace with a comma, period, or conjunction. Do not use em dashes in any content on this project." } }) | ConvertTo-Json -Compress } }
